title: disk-diagnose input — one Keep HQ disk alert (host allowlist is the enum)

host.description: Target host short name; the enum is the allowlist of hosts this agent may touch

mount.description: Absolute mount point the alert fired for (e.g. /)

usedPct.description: Disk usage percentage reported by the alert (0–100)

alertId.description: Keep HQ alert id this diagnosis answers, carried through for dedup and audit
